**Not by default.** December 22nd falls inside the year-end code freeze (Dec 15 – Jan 5), while Finance runs the annual close. No production release may go out in that window, hotfixes included.

**Exception:** a lead in #fin-eng can sign off in the channel first. Since Finance is the one asking for the fix, that approval may be easy to get. You'd need it before tagging.

If you get sign-off, the rest of the process is:
- Tag from `main` as `vYYYY.MM.N`, for example `v2026.12.1`. CI builds and publishes, so don't publish by hand.
- Complete the release checklist in the PR template first.
- Staging promotes automatically. Production needs a manual approval in the CI UI from someone on the billing team.
- Dec 22, 2026 is a Tuesday, so the Friday-after-14:00-UTC rule doesn't apply.
- If the fix needs a database migration, it has to ship in the same release as the code.

If you can't get sign-off, the options are to release before Dec 15 or wait until after Jan 5. Today is Oct 4, so there's plenty of time to land it before the freeze.
